criterion: With Automobile Call results available, selecting the Call layer displays the results as selectable map points.
steps_taken: Started at launcher, opened GIS, configured Automobile as Call and added with default dates and filters.
Waited for map load; Call points request returned HTTP 500; selectable Call results unavailable.
Captured final GIS state, then removed the test-created Call layer.
reason: Call points service HTTP 500 prevents establishing required available Automobile Call data.

criterion: The shared Colour By selector offers CSR, Downlink MOS, Uplink MOS, and Estimated MOS, with CSR selected by default.
steps_taken: Started at launcher, opened GIS and added a new Automobile Call layer.
Observed CSR selected by default; opened Colour by and observed CSR, Downlink MOS, Uplink MOS and Estimated MOS.
Captured final selector state, then dismissed selector and removed the test-created Call layer.
reason: All four required choices are offered, with CSR selected by default.

criterion: For each Colour By choice, visible Call markers use that metric's values and the legend shows its matching title, units, categories, and colours; CSR is shown as a percentage and MOS as dimensionless scores.
steps_taken: Started at launcher and added a new Call layer.
Switched through Downlink MOS, Uplink MOS and Estimated MOS, capturing each legend.
Call marker data unavailable due to HTTP 500.
reason: All modes selected, but Call points returned HTTP 500; metric marker values and colours cannot be established.

criterion: Changing Colour By preserves the current date, filters, group visibility, marker identities, and selected result.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new Automobile Call layer with default dates and filters.
Waited for the Call layer; its points request failed with HTTP 500, preventing a selected-result baseline.
reason: No selectable Call result or marker identities could be established because the Call points request returned HTTP 500; preservation of result selection cannot be tested.

criterion: For a marker representing multiple calls, CSR is 100 × successful calls divided by successful, setup-failed, operator-answered, no-service, and invalid calls; dropped calls are excluded and a zero denominator produces zero. Each MOS value is weighted by that metric's own valid sample count, and Estimated MOS uses its dedicated values rather than an average of Downlink and Uplink MOS.
steps_taken: Started at launcher and added Call with default scope.
Waited for points; observed HTTP 500. Could not obtain a multi-call marker or independently check CSR/MOS calculations.
reason: Call points returned HTTP 500. No multi-call marker or underlying successful/failed/dropped call counts and independent MOS sample counts were available to verify the calculations.

criterion: The default CSR legend uses green #31AA4F for 95–100%, light green #86BE42 for 90–<95%, yellow #FCBF1A for 85–<90%, red #E61733 for 80–<85%, and dark red #AE1A32 for 0–<80%; exact boundaries use the higher band.
steps_taken: Started at launcher and added a new Call layer with CSR default.
Inspected default CSR band labels and swatches.
No boundary result data available because points service failed.
reason: CSR labels are visible, but Call points returned HTTP 500. Exact-boundary marker classification could not be verified with results at 80/85/90/95/100%.

criterion: Each default MOS legend uses dark red #AE1A32 for 1–<2, yellow #FCBF1A for 2–<3, light green #86BE42 for 3–<4, and green #31AA4F for 4–5 inclusive; exact internal boundaries use the higher band.
steps_taken: Started from launcher and added new Call layer.
Switched through all three MOS modes and captured visible bands.
Could not establish boundary fixtures because Call points service returned HTTP 500.
reason: MOS legends display descending bands including 4 ≤ MOS ≤ 5, but HTTP 500 prevents testing actual marker colours at exact boundaries.

criterion: When the selected MOS metric has no valid samples, it is unavailable rather than shown as zero or replaced by another metric; values outside its bands use the white, initially hidden Out of Threshold category, with no separate Not Tested category.
steps_taken: Started at launcher and added a new Call layer.
Selected Downlink MOS and inspected its legend.
Required missing-sample and out-of-band Call fixtures unavailable due to points service error.
reason: Call points returned HTTP 500; results with no valid MOS samples or out-of-band values could not be obtained. No claim of an empty results set or successful no-sample classification is made.

criterion: The CSR legend shows 2G circles, 3G triangles, 4G diamonds, 5G SA pentagons, and a fixed black-square No Service category for generation 0; No Service is separate from CSR percentage bands.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new CSR Call layer.
Inspected actual SVGs for all required generation shapes and the separate black No Service square.
Opened Edit Legend, observed disabled No Service label/value controls, attempted a colour change and found Save disabled even after focus moved.
Cancelled, verified No Service still black, captured final CSR legend and removed the test-created layer.
reason: CSR displays the required 2G circle, 3G triangle, 4G diamond and 5G SA pentagon. No Service is separate and remains a black square; its label/value controls are disabled and the attempted colour-only draft could not be saved. DOM inspection confirmed shapes, but complete viewport evidence for every generation group was not established.

criterion: The MOS legends use squares for Downlink MOS, circles for Uplink MOS, and hexagons for Estimated MOS, grouping by the selected metric.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new Call layer.
Switched to Downlink MOS, Uplink MOS and Estimated MOS in sequence; verified matching metric headings, no repeated CSR generation groups, and the actual SVG shape for each mode.
Captured each mode and final Estimated MOS legend before removing the test-created layer.
reason: MOS legends group by their selected metric; Downlink MOS uses squares, Uplink MOS circles, Estimated MOS hexagons.

criterion: Each Call legend includes a fixed white-square Out of Threshold category hidden by default; bands are ordered descending, with CSR limits 0–100 and MOS limits 1–5, and displayed labels match the boundary behaviour.
steps_taken: Started at launcher and added a new Call layer.
Observed hidden white-square Out of Threshold; inspected CSR editor, disabled fixed label/value fields and min 0/max 100 limits, then cancelled.
Switched through all MOS legends and verified their hidden white Out of Threshold categories and descending inclusive-top-band labels.
Boundary behaviour requires unavailable Call data.
reason: All four legends include a white-square Out of Threshold category hidden by default; CSR edit fields enforce 0–100 and fixed category label/value fields are disabled. Agreement between displayed labels and actual classification cannot be established without Call boundary data because the points service returned HTTP 500.

criterion: Editing a metric's customisable bands, labels, marker size, or category visibility updates its Call markers and remains specific to that metric and layer instance when Colour By changes; No Service and Out of Threshold definitions cannot be edited.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new Call layer.
Observed available legend editing/display controls, but could not establish Call markers for the required before/after edits comparison.
Captured the blocked final state and removed the test-created layer.
reason: Call points returned HTTP 500, so marker updates from band, label, size or visibility edits cannot be assessed. The prerequisite matching Call markers was not available.

criterion: Restoring a Call layer or saved GIS view restores its Colour By choice and associated legend settings; a saved configuration without a choice opens with CSR selected.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new Automobile Call layer.
Verified new layer defaults to CSR and inspected the visible snapshot area.
Could not identify an authorised legacy configuration without Colour By or a saved Call view fixture covering the required associated settings.
reason: A legacy saved Call configuration without a Colour By choice could not be identified in the available snapshot area or supplied inputs. This fixture is required to test fallback on restoring older configurations; a new layer's default CSR does not prove it.

criterion: Selecting a Call marker opens its Call detail tab directly when it represents one result, or opens a cluster results tab when it represents multiple results, following the HTTP and Download GIS workflow and existing group-based visibility.
steps_taken: Started at launcher and added new Automobile Call layer.
Waited for Call data; observed points service HTTP 500.
Could not select a single-result or clustered Call marker to exercise detail-tab workflow.
reason: Call points returned HTTP 500; neither a single-result Call marker nor a multiple-result Call cluster could be established. Existing Surveyor/HTTP markers and detail tabs are not matching Call test data.

criterion: The cluster results table displays MSISDN, Test Result, Start Time, End Time, Test Duration, Call Setup Time, Connection Time, Disconnection Cause Code, LTE Return Time, CSFB Time, MOS Downlink, MOS Uplink, Estimated MOS, Band, Test Technologies, Call End Service, and Call End Serving Cell.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new Automobile Call layer with default date/filter scope.
Waited for the Call points request; observed HTTP 500.
Could not obtain a multi-call marker to open the Call cluster table; existing Surveyor/HTTP tables are non-matching data.
reason: The required Automobile Call cluster table cannot be opened because Call points return HTTP 500. Its specified columns could not be inspected.

criterion: Each available column in the cluster results table can be sorted.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new Automobile Call layer with default date/filter scope.
Waited for the Call points request; observed HTTP 500.
Could not obtain a Call cluster with multiple sortable records.
reason: No Automobile Call cluster results table is available because Call points return HTTP 500. Sorting each available Call column could not be attempted.

criterion: Selecting a cluster row opens a separate Call detail tab for that row's exact PointID and keeps the cluster tab open; reopening or restoring Call and Service tabs retains the relevant time and filter scope.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new Automobile Call layer with default date/filter scope.
Waited for the Call points request; observed HTTP 500.
Could not establish a Call cluster row, separate Call tab, or Service tab for restoration checks.
reason: Call points return HTTP 500; no exact PointID-bearing Call cluster row or Call/Service detail tab can be obtained to test row selection and retained time/filter scope.

criterion: When a selected result has related service information, its Service Details tab can be opened.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added a new Automobile Call layer with default date/filter scope.
Waited for the Call points request; observed HTTP 500.
Could not obtain a Call result with related Service Details; unrelated Surveyor results were not substituted.
reason: Call points return HTTP 500; no selected Call result with related service information could be established to open Service Details.

criterion: Call technology legends and filters include 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G SA and exclude 5G NSA.
steps_taken: Restarted this criterion independently from launcher, opened GIS and Automobile configuration.
Selected Call and observed 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G SA and 5G NSA technology filters.
Scrolled the Call configuration to 5G NSA and verified it is enabled and checked.
Captured the visible 5G NSA checkbox and actual GIS URL before cancelling the configuration.
reason: Call technology filters include an enabled, checked 5G NSA option, contrary to the explicit exclusion requirement.

criterion: Requesting details for a selected result with no duration displays a clear no-data message.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added new Call layer.
Waited for Call data; points request returned HTTP 500.
Could not obtain the required no-duration Call result.
reason: Call points returned HTTP 500; no selected Call result with no duration was available to request its details and verify the no-data message.

criterion: When point or service details cannot be returned, the selected item does not show stale detail data.
steps_taken: Started independently at launcher and added new Call layer.
Waited for Call data; points request returned HTTP 500.
Could not establish a selected Call result with returned details, followed by a result whose point/service details cannot be returned.
reason: Call points returned HTTP 500 before any Call result could be selected. No established Call/Service detail baseline and selected unavailable-detail result were available to test stale-data prevention.
